nodes.description: CTLA4-Ig binds CD80/CD86 and limits CD28-dependent costimulation. Retrospective cohorts and small case series report benefit, especially for enteropathy and lymphoproliferation. The 2026 ABACHAI single-arm trial enrolled 18 adults with CTLA4 insufficiency and two with LRBA deficiency; pooled results showed improvement in lymphoproliferation and immune activation, but insufficient control of cytopenias and renal involvement. Responses are organ dependent and the trial did not provide a randomized comparator.
